name: Gridly WPML Plugin
author: Gridly

sections.description:
Localize WordPress websites efficiently with a platform that centralizes your translation work.

Remove Manual Work from Website Localization

Forget about endless copying, pasting, and switching between different tools when translating WordPress websites. Prepare, translate, track, and publish translations in Gridly.

Cut Down on Translation Cost

Get contextual and high-quality translations with Machine Translation and Generative AI. Build up your own Translation Memory and Glossaries with previously translated WordPress content you can conveniently reuse.

Empower Your Translators

With Gridly’s familiar spreadsheet interface, you can onboard your translators quickly. Simplify their work with capable features for filtering, organizing, and managing translations across multiple languages. Gridly provides translators with a platform that combines productivity with an enjoyable work experience.

Connect Seamlessly with WPML

Integrated with WPML, the Gridly plugin allows you to create and manage translation jobs inside WordPress. Assigned translators can access and translate the content in Gridly, then sync the completed translations back to WordPress with a single click.

How It Works:

  1. Select posts and pages you want to translate using WPML
  2. Push selected content from WordPress to Gridly
  3. Access and translate content in Gridly
  4. Sync completed translations back to WordPress
    Start localizing your WordPress website more efficiently with Gridly today!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gridly-wpml-plugin directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Follow the instructions to connect to your Gridly account.

Check out our plugin documentation.

Refer to our translator’s guide.
